proves.claim: A registered seat's presence heartbeat with overlaps off sends no item-list query to the board.

cli.io-presence.overlaps-off-no-item-que.why: Without it, a regression where every claiming next lists the whole board's items for overlap lines it never prints would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: With overlaps on and two claims recording the same file, the presence heartbeat prints the claim overlap line.

cli.io-presence.overlaps-on-prints-line.why: Without it, a regression where the heartbeat stops printing a claim overlap once the item list is read lazily would pass unnoticed.
